entries.title: Firstmate can add a few words to its gestures
entries.body: When Firstmate reacts with a gesture, it can now add a few words, up to 40 characters, shown just above the character where "Thinking…" appears on your first turn. The words fade after a few seconds. A reply such as "On it" waits until Firstmate has finished its turn, like the gesture does.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.
